en: A black-and-white photograph of a European town street, likely from the early 20th century. The street is lined with historic buildings with ornate facades and shutters. On the left, there is a building with the sign 'Städtische Volksbibliothek' (Municipal Public Library in German). A fountain or monument stands in the middle distance, and there are several people, including children and adults, standing and walking along the street. Another visible sign on a building reads 'Paul Thieme.' The scene is peaceful, with a cobblestone street and tram tracks visible.
